title: An AI-Guided Data Centric Strategy to Detect and Mitigate Biases in Healthcare Datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on detecting and mitigating racial, gender, age, and socioeconomic biases in healthcare datasets.
findings: The paper does not investigate or report any findings related to religion, faith, or religious bias.
